title: Run 4 · AQBCE expert cache profile seeding
purpose: Determine whether a disjoint routing profile can seed AQBC’s existing GPU expert cache at startup and reduce latency with unchanged greedy output, prompt reuse, placement and caps.

covers: Released AQBC source, mixed pack, prefill plan and request reuse policy.
A startup-only opt-in that fills evictable slots in the existing GPU expert cache.
Independent target comparison of switch-off and switch-on arms using the candidate image.
excludes: New cache banks, routing or math changes, prediction, prefetch and repacking.
Any load in the factory or use of measured prompts as calibration.

prompt_2048.description: Fixed text that renders to 2048 tokens with the Muse no-thinking chat template.

sampled_peak_memory_bytes.how: Highest sampled resident memory of the engine process group under the cap.

ready_seconds.how: Process start to health ready; include startup fills.

pack_bytes.how: Disk bytes of the digest-verified pack.

available_memory_floor_bytes.how: Lowest observed MemAvailable during the load.

device_model_mib.how: Recorded model component from the device-budget accounting.

device_kv_mib.how: Recorded KV component from the load log.

device_compute_mib.how: Recorded device compute category from the load log.

host_compute_mib.how: Recorded host compute category from the load log.

device_accounted_mib.how: Total from the comparable recorded budget categories.

device_headroom_mib.how: Recorded remaining headroom versus the 110000 MiB budget.

fit_margin_mib.how: Fit margin as recorded by the engine.

protocol.notes: Record the first 512-token request before W2. After W2 repeat matched warm-first and warmed same-document follow-up cells at 512 and 2048. Retain readiness, native cache lookups, actual output identities and complete load receipts. This is a shared machine; record background activity without filtering samples. Before admission stop our own builds, tests and helpers; defer only while another user’s process is using more than two CPU cores, in addition to the machine safety gate.

checks.does: Greedy generated token IDs agree across on/off first, warm and follow-up requests. Retain the tokens and hashes.
Use the AQBC prompt policy and retain restored token counts at both follow-up lengths.

Use the same image and binary with unchanged pack, prefill, prompt and runtime settings. Verify the attached profile digest and disjoint calibration prompt identities. Off never fills at startup; on publishes actual complete startup slots.

After the separately measured first request and before the warm cells, send untimed fresh documents disjoint from measured and calibration documents. Stop at two consecutive decode rates within 10% or six requests. Preserve each request identity, TTFT, decode speed, total latency and stop reason.

Retain each capped-run and load source: pack bytes and digest, peak server RSS and MemAvailable floor, GPU cache allocation, model/KV/compute/host-compute categories, total versus 110000 MiB and headroom, and recorded fit margin. Enforce 96 GiB, zero swap, one model at a time, and no automatic retries.

Record process start to ready, seed duration, admitted and populated slots, charged/uploaded bytes, bytes by layer group, and startup versus demand hits and evictions. Attach source receipts for both arms; zero only when observed.
The target lab applies these acceptance rules to the raw, same-image comparison and explicitly passes or fails E. The factory’s estimate is not a performance result.

rules: A missing, invalid, unrepresentative or low-headroom sealed trace cannot authorize candidate editing, building or delivery.
Require at least 5% lower median TTFT in one warm 512- or 2048-token cell, every candidate sample in that cell below its control median, and higher measured native cache hit rate in the same cell.

Require bit-exact greedy tokens and unchanged prompt reuse. No comparable TTFT, total latency or decode-rate cell may regress by more than 10%. Report added readiness time separately and require at most 120 seconds.

Record background activity without excluding any rows. Follow the admission gate, all machine caps, complete source-linked receipts and the independent verdict by 2026-11-29T18:00:00-05:00. Otherwise retain the actual stop or refusal and leave AQBC released.

execution.notes: Factory checks and builds never load Muse. Only the independent operator can acquire the optional trace-only AQBC profile and then run one switch-off and one switch-on load after verified delivery. Maximum three serial capped loads, no automatic retries.

notes: The prior v1.3 DeepSeek result motivates the Muse hypothesis; it is not Muse performance evidence.
